# Faculty of Arts, University of Peradeniya

> > The Faculty of Arts at the University of Peradeniya is Sri Lanka's premier institution for humanities and social sciences education, offering undergraduate and postgraduate programs across 15+ academic departments.

The Faculty of Arts serves as the hub for liberal arts education at the University of Peradeniya, encompassing diverse disciplines from classical languages and archaeology to law, economics, and psychology. The faculty maintains strong research initiatives, heritage preservation projects, and community engagement through its constituent departments.

## Faculty Overview & Administration

- [Faculty of Arts Homepage](https://arts.pdn.ac.lk): Faculty portal with departments, academic programs, student resources, and announcements
- [Vision & Mission](https://arts.pdn.ac.lk/vision.php): Faculty vision, mission, and academic department overview
- [General Information](https://arts.pdn.ac.lk/general.php): General faculty information, historical background, and organizational structure
- [Dean's Message](https://arts.pdn.ac.lk/message.php): Welcome message from Dean Dr. E.M.P.C.S. Ekanayake with faculty overview
- [Faculty Statistics](https://arts.pdn.ac.lk/stats.php): Faculty statistics, enrollment data, staff directory, and academic program information
- [Faculty Contacts](http://arts.pdn.ac.lk//services/fac_contacts.php): Department contact information, extensions, postal address, and faculty directory

## Academic Departments

- [Department of Law](http://arts.pdn.ac.lk/law): LL.B program, clinical education, mooting activities, and legal research
- [Department of Education](http://arts.pdn.ac.lk/education): Teacher education and postgraduate diploma programs in educational studies
- [Department of Archaeology](http://arts.pdn.ac.lk/archaeologynew): Archaeology programs, excavation projects, and cultural heritage preservation
- [Department of English](http://arts.pdn.ac.lk/english): Established 1947, offering programs with prizes, scholarships, and academic events
- [Department of Economics & Statistics](http://arts.pdn.ac.lk/econ): Economics and statistics programs, research symposium, and economic analysis
- [Department of History](http://arts.pdn.ac.lk/history): Undergraduate and postgraduate research programs in historical studies
- [Department of Geography](http://arts.pdn.ac.lk/geography): Geography programs with field surveys, GIS applications, and research projects
- [Department of Psychology](http://arts.pdn.ac.lk/psychology): Undergraduate, postgraduate, and counseling programs in psychology
- [Department of Philosophy](http://arts.pdn.ac.lk/Philosophy): Undergraduate and postgraduate degree programs in philosophical studies
- [Department of Fine Arts](http://arts.pdn.ac.lk/finearts): Undergraduate and postgraduate programs in visual arts and creative practice

## Language & Civilization Studies

- [Department of Arabic & Islamic Civilization](http://arts.pdn.ac.lk/arabic): Arabic language and Islamic civilization programs with cultural studies
- [Department of Classical Languages](http://arts.pdn.ac.lk/classical): Undergraduate and postgraduate programs in classical language studies
- [Department of Pali](http://arts.pdn.ac.lk/Pali): Pali language and Buddhist Studies heritage and language programs
